project_name.justification: The transaction concerns claims that are part of the Red Lake Gold Project: '...divested four (4) mining claims...representing less than 0.4% of the claim count of its Red Lake Gold Project...'

company_name.justification: The text identifies the acquiring company (buyer) as Great Bear Resources Ltd. in the sentence: 'The Claim Sale was conducted by way of a purchase-and-sale agreement dated July 9, 2024 with Great Bear Resources Ltd. (“GBR”)...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The text identifies the buyer as Great Bear Resources Ltd. but does not name its CEO. The CEO mentioned, Ryan Kalt, is the CEO of the seller, Dixie Gold Inc.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The transaction is described as a 'divestment' of 'four (4) mining claims' through a 'purchase-and-sale agreement', which implies a 100% acquisition of those specific assets.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly named the 'Red Lake Gold Project' and the retained royalty is on 'any gold or other metal production'.

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source text.

currency.justification: The cash consideration is '$100,000'. The seller, Dixie Gold Inc., is based in Vancouver, British Columbia and is listed on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), which implies the currency is Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The text states: 'In connection with the Claim Sale, the Corporation received cash consideration of $100,000...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction terms only mention cash consideration and a royalty, with no mention of share payments.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The text explicitly provides a value for cash payments, so this combined field is not applicable.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants were mentioned as part of the transaction.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options were mentioned as part of the transaction.
